relationships.evidence_quote: Combined with the previous result, we could infer that LOC100911498 may be involved in the generation of mechanical allodynia induced by SNI.

key_findings: LOC100911498 is upregulated in spinal cord of SNI rats and its siRNA knockdown raises mechanical withdrawal threshold.
Knockdown reduced spinal P2X4R, Iba-1, p-p38 and BDNF, supporting a P2X4R-p38-BDNF microglial mechanism.
